title: Kraken integrates with ICE Chat to expand institutional OTC access
summary: The integration gives ICE Chat users direct access to the exchange's OTC crypto liquidity, embedding digital asset trading within established institutional workflows.

title: CFTC chair doubles down on defending prediction markets from state suits
summary: Michael Selig said that the US financial regulator had filed an amicus brief against what he called an “onslaught of state-led litigation” against prediction markets.

title: Amid crypto VC shakeout, Dragonfly closes $650M fund with focus on real-world assets
summary: Dragonfly’s raise comes as crypto venture capital shifts toward tokenized real-world assets, payments and core financial infrastructure that enables institutional participation.

title: Bitcoin stays pinned below $70K as BTC’s negative funding rate flashes warning sign
summary: Bitcoin’s negative funding rate and a cooling tech sector in the US add pressure to markets and contribute to BTC failing to trade above $70,000.

title: Top crypto treasury companies Strategy and Bitmine add to BTC, ETH stacks
summary: The buys lift Strategy holdings to 717,131 BTC and Bitmine to 4.37 million ETH, expanding corporate crypto treasuries despite continued market weakness.

title: Macro headwinds test Bitcoin price as $70K crumbles amid US market volatility
summary: Bitcoin bulls’ attempt to break above $70,000 stalled after a key US macroeconomic “fear” metric broke a critical threshold. Is a revisit to BTC's yearly lows back in play?

title: Nakamoto to acquire BTC Inc, UTXO in $107M all-stock deal
summary: Nakamoto will acquire BTC Inc and UTXO in an all-stock deal, consolidating Bitcoin media, events and asset management under one Nasdaq-listed company.

title: Gemini post-IPO shakeup sees exit of three top executives
summary: The exchange's chief legal officer, chief operating officer and chief financial officer are out and Cameron Winkelvoss will take on more responsibilities.

title: South Korea lifts 9-year corporate crypto ban: What the policy change means
summary: South Korea reopens crypto to corporations with strict caps and asset limits. This is part of a broader strategy that includes stablecoin legislation and potential spot crypto ETFs.

title: Bitcoin price ignores $168M Strategy buy, and falls as Iran tensions escalate
summary: BTC price fell below the key $70,000 level as tensions between the US and Iran ramped up and a broad risk-asset sell-off liquidated late BTC long positions.
